subject.title: [Bug]: Lane remains occupied after reply emitted during failover — blocks subsequent inbound messages

question: Should durable visible reply delivery be allowed to release or bypass the same-session command lane while provider failover cleanup continues?
rationale: The source shows the requested behavior crosses lane ownership, reply delivery, transcript ordering, and failover cleanup semantics, so automation should not choose the policy boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt guarded visible-delivery handoff
options.body: Allow follow-up admission after durable visible delivery only with explicit ordering, transcript, cleanup, and timeout barriers plus live Telegram/provider-failover proof.

options.title: Keep full-run lane ownership
options.body: Preserve the current rule that a same-session lane is unavailable until the embedded task fully settles, accepting user-visible blocking during slow failover cleanup.

options.title: Limit repair to stale recovery
options.body: Improve timeout or stuck-lane recovery without changing normal delivery-based lane admission semantics.

recommendation.title: Adopt guarded visible-delivery handoff
recommendation.body: Allow follow-up admission after durable visible delivery only with explicit ordering, transcript, cleanup, and timeout barriers plus live Telegram/provider-failover proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent reply-lifecycle work spans the embedded runner, dispatch path, and reply-run registry surfaces where this policy would land.
